intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Rancho Cucamonga for 2026, and here is what he found: 14 family events. The magic runs from November 6 (Santa Photos at Victoria Gardens and the Nightly Holiday Light Shows) through December 24, with the Strolling Charles Dickens Carolers (November 27), the Thoroughbred Holiday Lights Drive-Thru (December 4 to 24), Breakfast with Santa (December 5), The Nutcracker (December 5 and 6) and Snow Much Fun Day (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Rancho Cucamonga

  • 14 Christmas events for kids in Rancho Cucamonga
  • Free events: the Storytime with Mrs. Claus at Victoria Gardens is listed as free (the free count for the other live cards is for the publisher's quick-counts to confirm)
  • Meet Santa: Santa Photos at Victoria Gardens (November 6 to December 24), Pet Photos with Santa, Breakfast with Santa (December 5), Santa Cares (December 6) and Snow Much Fun Day (December 12)
  • Lights and shows: the Nightly Holiday Light Shows at Victoria Gardens (through December 24), the Thoroughbred Holiday Lights Drive-Thru (December 4 to 24), The Nutcracker (December 5 and 6), Santa's Little Helpers (December 11) and The Hot Sardines Holiday Stomp (December 20)
  • Trains: no holiday train in Rancho Cucamonga itself (see our California Christmas train rides guide)
  • Season: November 6 to December 24

Planning a bigger day out? Rancho Cucamonga families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Riverside, which covers the Mission Inn Festival of Lights and more.
